water.name: Land
water.rule: At least 4 of the hex's 7 sample points (centre + 6) fall on a province (geoBoundaries) or a neighbouring country (Natural Earth), unless the centre is sea and the ETOPO 2022 mean is at or below sea level, or at least half its ETOPO samples are.

water.name: Open sea
water.rule: Sea deeper than 40 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coastal water
water.rule: Sea or lagoon next to a land hex, or shallower than 40 m (ETOPO 2022 mean).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: At least half of the hex's land-cover points are permanent water (ESA WorldCover 2021) and the water surface is above sea level (ETOPO 2022). A lake hex next to the sea stays a lake only where Natural Earth has a lake; otherwise it is a lagoon (coastal water).

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 28 m.

relief.name: Hills
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation of 28 m or more (hills, uplands, the edges of the plateaus).

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation of 110 m or more, or mean elevation of 750 m or more.

relief.name: Peaks
relief.rule: Mountains whose highest sample reaches 2,900 m (the Hoang Lien Son range with Fansipan, and the highest summits near it).

cover.name: None
cover.rule: Water, or no WorldCover land points.

cover.name: Broadleaf forest
cover.rule: Tree cover (WorldCover 10) is the largest group and broad-leaved forest (evergreen or deciduous) the largest forest type (Copernicus forest type layer 2019).

cover.name: Pine forest
cover.rule: Tree cover is the largest group and needle-leaved forest (the pine forests of the highlands) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Tree cover is the largest group and mixed forest the largest forest type, or the type is unknown.

cover.name: Mountain grassland
cover.rule: Grassland (30) or moss and lichen (100) is the largest group in a hex 900 m or higher.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Grassland (WorldCover 30) is the largest group in a hex under 900 m.

cover.name: Farmland
cover.rule: Cropland (WorldCover 40: rice paddies and other crops) is the largest group.

cover.name: Wetland and mangroves
cover.rule: Herbaceous wetland (WorldCover 90) or mangroves (95) is the largest group.

cover.name: Built-up
cover.rule: Built-up land (WorldCover 50) is 28% or more of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Bare rock and sand
cover.rule: Bare or sparse vegetation (60: rock, dunes, quarries) is the largest group.

cover.name: Snow and ice
cover.rule: Permanent snow and ice (70) is the largest group.

notes.water: Province outlines (geoBoundaries) and Natural Earth 1:10m country outlines do not meet exactly. A sea hex whose ETOPO 2022 mean is above sea level (and under half of its samples below it) becomes land when at least 4 of its 6 neighbours are land, or when it touches both Vietnamese and foreign land; it takes the neighbours' majority owner. Lakes and the land of islands and spits smaller than a hex are drawn as outlines over the hexes (world.json lakes and spits); the islands of the Hoàng Sa and Trường Sa archipelagos are drawn as island marks (world.json archipelagos). A sea hex's elevation is the mean of its ETOPO samples below sea level (its water depth).
notes.relief: From ETOPO 2022 samples (15 arc-second, about 460 m by 450 m, roughly 140 per hex) at -30 m or higher, so lagoons and sea floor do not count; all samples are used if none qualify. Water hexes are always flat. A hex whose lower 60% of samples is flat lowland (spread under 15 m, under 300 m) is eased one class.
notes.cover: From ESA WorldCover 2021 (read at 1/375 degree, about 300 m by 290 m), sampled on a 450 m lattice inside each hex (about 320 points). Water and no-data points are ignored; shares are of the remaining land points, rounded to whole percent, and the built-up threshold is applied to the rounded share. The forest type (conifer, deciduous, mixed) is the most common type of the Copernicus Global Land Cover 2019 forest layer at the hex's tree points. Neighbouring countries get a cover class for the map art; their shares (pct) stay 0.
